newsitem.title: UK: UK shares end slightly lower, rate worries weigh.
newsitem.headline: UK shares end slightly lower, rate worries weigh.

text.p: A two-day UK share rally ran out of steam on Tuesday as a weak Wall Street and continued worries about possible interest rate hikes pushed prices marginally lower.
Trading volume remained light as many participants stayed away due to fears that both the FTSE and the Dow Industrials Average may suffer further sharp losses in the medium term, dealers said.
"There is little confidence in this market at the moment," the head of trading at a large brokerage said. "No one is convinced we've seen the bottom."
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares closed 2.4 points down to 4,269.3.
